questions.subject: Environment & Ecology
questions.question:
Consider the following about Galaxy Frogs:
1. They are endemic to the Western Ghats (Kerala)
2. They are listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List
3. They are in CITES Appendix I
4. They are a recently discovered genus of frogs
questions.explanation: All correct. Galaxy Frogs (Astrobatrachus kurichiyana): discovered 2019 in Wayanad, Kerala. Endemic to Western Ghats. IUCN Vulnerable, CITES Appendix I (highest trade protection). Named for star-like markings on skin. Part of an ancient lineage (only member of subfamily Astrobatrachinae). Western Ghats is home to numerous endemic amphibians (400+ species). Threats: habitat loss from plantation agriculture, climate change affecting montane habitats.

questions.subject: Environment & Ecology
questions.question:
With reference to Sambhar Lake (Rajasthan):
1. It is India's largest inland salt lake
2. It is a Ramsar site
3. It supports migratory birds, especially flamingos
4. It is also important for salt production (contributes to India's salt output)
questions.explanation: All correct. Sambhar Lake (Rajasthan, ~230 sq km): India's largest inland salt/saline lake. Designated Ramsar site (1990). Important bird area: flamingos, pelicans, and other migratory waterfowl. Also commercially important: produces salt (Sambhar Salts Ltd, ~8% of India's salt production). Ecological concern: avian botulism outbreaks killed 18,000+ migratory birds (2019). Lake is fed by Mendha, Rupangarh, Khari rivers. Also listed under Important Bird Areas (IBA).

questions.subject: Economics
questions.question:
Consider India's global rankings in key areas:
1. India ranks 3rd globally in GDP (PPP terms)
2. India ranks 4th globally in FDI inflows
3. India's Global Innovation Index improved from 81st (2015) to 39th (2024)
4. India ranks 1st globally in rice and wheat production
questions.explanation: 1, 2, 3 correct. Statement 4 WRONG — India ranks 2nd in rice (after China) and 2nd in wheat (after China). NOT 1st. India IS the largest EXPORTER of rice globally but not the largest producer. GII rank: 81st (2015) → 46th (2021) → 40th (2023) → 39th (2024). FDI: $64.7 billion (Apr-Nov 2025), 4th globally. India also ranks 12th in entrepreneurship policy, 4th in trademarks, 6th in patents.

questions.subject: Economics
questions.question:
With reference to India's innovation ecosystem:
1. India's GII rank improved from 81 (2015) to under 40 (2024)
2. India ranks among top 10 globally in industrial design filings
3. India has 100+ unicorn startups
4. DPIIT recognizes startups under the Startup India initiative
questions.explanation: All correct. India's innovation metrics: GII 39th (2024, up from 81st in 2015 — among fastest improvements globally). 7th in industrial designs, 6th in patents, 4th in trademarks (by application volume). 100+ unicorns (3rd most after US, China). DPIIT recognition: 1.4 lakh+ startups recognized, benefits include tax exemption (3 years), self-certification for labour/environment laws, IPR fast-track, Fund of Funds access. India: 3rd largest startup ecosystem globally.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.question:
Consider the following about India's SDG performance:
1. India's SDG India Index is published by NITI Aayog
2. Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Himachal Pradesh are among top-performing states
3. Bihar and Jharkhand are among the lowest-performing states
4. India has achieved all 17 SDGs as per the UN report
questions.explanation: 1, 2, 3 correct. Statement 4 WRONG — India has NOT achieved all SDGs. UN SDG Index 2026: India ranked 94th/167. Significant gaps in: SDG 2 (hunger), SDG 3 (health), SDG 5 (gender equality), SDG 14 (ocean conservation). NITI Aayog's SDG India Index: composite score of states on 16 goals (SDG 14 excluded for landlocked states). Top: Kerala (score ~80), TN, HP. Bottom: Bihar, Jharkhand, UP.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.question:
With reference to India's International Data Privacy Day:
1. It is observed on January 28 annually
2. It aims to raise awareness about data protection rights
3. India's DPDP Act 2023 is the relevant legislation
4. India was the first developing country to enact data protection legislation
questions.explanation: 1, 2, 3 correct. Statement 4 WRONG — India was NOT the first developing country to enact data protection legislation. Many developing countries had data protection laws before India's DPDP Act 2023 (e.g., South Africa's POPIA 2013, Brazil's LGPD 2018, Kenya's DPA 2019, Nigeria's NDPR 2019). India was actually LATE in enacting comprehensive data protection — the Supreme Court recognized Right to Privacy in 2017 (Puttaswamy), but the law took 6 more years.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.question:
Consider the following about National Voters' Day (January 25):
1. It was started in 2011 on the foundation day of the Election Commission
2. ECI was established on January 25, 1950
3. The theme focuses on increasing voter participation
4. SVEEP (Systematic Voters' Education and Electoral Participation) is ECI's voter awareness programme
questions.explanation: All correct. National Voters' Day (started 2011): ECI's foundation day (Jan 25, 1950 — one day before Republic Day). Purpose: encourage youth voter enrollment, improve participation. SVEEP (since 2009): ECI's flagship voter awareness programme — uses cultural events, social media, campus ambassadors to boost participation. India's voter turnout: ~67% (2024 LS elections). ECI target: reach non-voters through targeted awareness. New voters get Electoral Photo Identity Cards (EPIC) on this day.

questions.subject: Science & Technology
questions.question:
Consider the following about India's AI ecosystem achievements:
1. India ranks among top 5 globally in AI talent and research papers
2. IndiaAI Mission has allocated ₹10,000+ crore for AI infrastructure
3. India has developed indigenous Large Language Models for Indian languages
4. AIRAWAT is India's cloud computing platform for AI research
questions.explanation: All correct. India's AI: 5th largest AI talent pool globally. IndiaAI Mission (₹10,372 crore): compute infrastructure (10,000+ GPU target), AI datasets platform, application development, FutureSkills PRIME for skilling. Indigenous LLMs: Bhashini (translation), Sarvam AI (multilingual), IIT-developed models for Indian languages. AIRAWAT (AI Research, Analytics and Knowledge Assimilation platform): cloud computing platform providing AI researchers access to compute resources. India AI Safety Institute also being set up.

questions.subject: International Relations
questions.question:
Consider the following about India's terrorism ranking:
1. India figures in the top 15 most terrorism-affected countries
2. Pakistan was ranked as the most terrorism-affected country in recent indices
3. Global Terrorism Index is published by the Institute for Economics and Peace
4. India's counter-terrorism successes include reduced LWE violence and J&K improvement
questions.explanation: All correct. Global Terrorism Index (IEP, annual): Pakistan topped (most affected). India in top 15 due to J&K terrorism and LWE (though both declining). India's improvements: LWE violence down 70%+ from peak, J&K ceasefire violations reduced post-2021, NE insurgency largely resolved (Naga peace process, Bodo accord). Remaining challenges: cross-border terrorism from Pakistan, lone wolf attacks, online radicalization. India's FATF engagement also targets terror financing.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.question:
With reference to India's National Girl Child Day (January 24):
1. It aims to raise awareness about gender discrimination and girl child rights
2. Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) scheme is a flagship initiative for girl children
3. India's sex ratio at birth has improved from 918 (2014-15) to 929 (2019-21)
4. Child Sex Ratio is measured as females per 1000 males in 0-6 age group
questions.explanation: All correct. National Girl Child Day (Jan 24, since 2008): awareness about inequalities faced by girls (education, health, nutrition, safety). BBBP (2015): targets gender-biased sex selection, girl education, empowerment. SRB improvement: 918→929 (NFHS-4 to NFHS-5). Child Sex Ratio (Census 2011): 919/1000 (concerning decline from 927 in 2001). Initiatives: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (savings), CBSE curriculum on gender sensitivity, PC-PNDT Act enforcement against sex determination.
